label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.7…: Every composite is posterior to its components and…
locator: I q.3 a.7 co., second proof: omne compositum est posterius suis componentibus, et dependens ex eis
interpretation: 'Posterius' is read with the simple priority of q.3 a.1 (PriorSimply): each component of a composite is simply prior to it. Components are quantified over the same domain of beings.
